name: Smartling
description:
Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.

What you can do:
- Translate text instantly using Smartling's MT API, applying your glossary, style guide, and preferred terminology
- Search, tag, and review strings across your projects
- Create, monitor, and manage translation jobs — add or remove content, authorize work, and review job history
- Raise, track, and resolve string issues and quality questions between reviewers and linguists
- Look up glossaries, style guides, translation memory, and linguistic packages to check terminology and brand voice
- Review vendor and translator assignments, word count reports, and workflow details
- List projects, users, and accounts across your Smartling organization

Who it's for:
Localization managers, project managers, and engineers already working in Smartling who want fast answers or bulk actions without leaving their AI assistant — checking a job's status, triaging quality issues, pulling a report, or getting an instant translation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Smartling to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Smartling to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.smartling.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Smartling MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smartling lists 53 MCP tools, including smartling_add_issue_comment, smartling_add_strings_to_job, smartling_add_tags_to_strings, smartling_authorize_job, smartling_count_account_issues, smartling_count_project_issues, smartling_create_issue, smartling_create_job, smartling_create_strings, smartling_delete_issue_assignee, smartling_delete_issue_comment, and smartling_edit_issue_text.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Smartling?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Smartling in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Smartling requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Smartling is developed by Smartling, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
